7500.title: Persistent Connect transport: clean-checkout liveness investigation
7500.rootCauseOneLine: Initiating fault unestablished: both isolated trusted-main runs sustained TLS reuse, tunnel heartbeats, and proxied WebSockets beyond 90 seconds; the affected Windows/deployed-edge path was unavailable.
7500.proposedFix: No safe fix without a representative failing regression. Compare affected Windows and alternate network paths, then correlate sanitized request times with stored edge logs.
7500.caveats: Loopback Miniflare fixture directly exercises TunnelDO and TunnelSession but omits deployed account routing/authentication, Windows, enrolled daemon, ISP path, and VPN driver. Full probe and results are inline in the HTML.
